_comment: L5.a of docs/2026-09-07_latent_intent_design.zh.md — the FITTED imitation teacher, pre-registered 2026-09-07 (user decision: 400 steps, batch 1024, network initialization). MOTIVATION: L1 settled that the teacher cannot be dropped (the dense, teacher-free arms scored 2515/2603 m against native32's 1322 and brought the 2026-08 bank wiggle back), and L0 measured that the teacher we have is bad in a specific, quantified way: the imitation target is the inverse dynamics of the truth track, and flown open-loop it lands 2.5-7.8 km from the truth it was read off (N=4 7850 m, N=8 6381, N=16 4095, N=32 2537). 'Imitating the teacher perfectly' is therefore NOT 'flying the truth track' — the numeric form of the 2026-09-07 control-training review's defect B. Fitted through the same differentiable rollout at the same width, the schedule reproduces the truth to 88-433 m: a strictly better teacher, and the only change here. SETTINGS: the table is fitted by `run_ts.py control_basis_oracle --checkpoint <l1_lowdim_20260907/L1_native32/checkpoint.pt> --out 4dTrajectory/outputs/KRDU/experiments/l5_fitted_teacher_20260907 --splits train,val --init network --steps 400 --batch-size 1024` over the checkpoint's OWN train and validation splits (validation too — the imitation component is only defined on a split it covers; test is never fitted). 400 steps rather than L0's 1200 because L0's convergence evidence says the last 10 % of that budget bought 0.4-1.2 %, and because the network seed starts far closer than the inverse dynamics did (straight-in approaches are already within 445 m); expect 2-3 h per arm. BASE = L1_native32 exactly (simple-v3 content, custom name, N=32, native segment endpoints, true-time-position, velocity 0.003), so the ONLY axis against that arm is which schedule the imitation term imitates. ARMS: L5_fitted64 keeps the deployed dose 64.0; L5_fitted16 quarters it, because the dose was calibrated against a teacher an order of magnitude further from the truth and a better teacher may want less pull, not more (the dose curve is a noisy plateau below ~11.8x position and overshoots past ~47x, so 16 and 64 bracket the useful region rather than extending it). PRE-REGISTERED READING, same instruments as L1 (docs/compare_constraint_arms.py + docs/score_control_arms.py): (1) top-1 ADE / FDE p50 per stratum against L1_native32, on BOTH metric families; the vectored stratum is where a teacher 2.5-7.8 km from the truth should have been costing something, so that is where an improvement is expected and where its absence is the result; (2) bank skill read against the random-flight floor (0.17) and the same-runway twin ceiling (0.70) that score_control_arms prints per arm, never against 1.0; (3) flyability as a DELTA against observed tracks, paired with the error metrics; (4) the fit's own wall time and its fitADE / seedADE distributions (the table stamps both per flight) go in the results document — a table whose fitADE is not far below its seedADE did not converge and its arm's numbers are the optimiser's shape, not the teacher's. GATES: top-1 ADE/FDE p50 not worse than L1_native32 in any stratum, AND bank skill >= 0.70. RISK, stated first: the fit minimises POSITION only, so nothing in it penalises a jittery bank and the table may carry wiggle of its own — if bank skill drops, the fix is at the FITTING end (a smoothness prior in the fit objective), never at the training end, because a training-side patch would hide which of the two produced the wiggle. VETO: straight-in FDE p50 degraded beyond seed noise. NOTE the table is width-, anchor- and duration-specific by construction; the dataset build refuses one that is not this cohort's, so a stale table cannot silently train the wrong thing.
